heading: Daniel's Penitential Prayer and Gabriel's Return
ascii:
THE THEOLOGICAL LINKAGE: DANIEL 8 & DANIEL 9
DANIEL 8 (The Unexplained Vision)          DANIEL 9 (The Inspired Explanation)
- 2,300 Evening-Mornings (8:14)            - Gabriel returns: "Consider the vision" (9:23)
- Left without a starting date             - 70 Weeks "cut off" (chathak) to anchor the span (9:24)
- Daniel faints sick for days (8:27)       - Gabriel gives the "going forth of the decree" (9:25)
- Focus: Heavenly Sanctuary & Tamid        - Focus: Messiah Cut Off & Covenant Confirmed (9:26-27)

heading: The Hebrew Verb Chathak: Severed from the 2,300 Days
ascii:
CHATHAK: SEVERING 490 YEARS FROM THE 2,300-YEAR PARENT TIMELINE
------------------------- 2,300 YEARS (Daniel 8:14) -------------------------
----- 490 YEARS (70 Weeks) --------------------- 1,810 YEARS ----------------
-    "CHATHAK" (Cut Off)        -                                            -
457 B.C.                    A.D. 34                                     1844 A.D.
Decree to Restore & Build   Gospel to Gentiles               Cleansing of Sanctuary

heading: Four Persian Decrees: Identifying the 457 B.C. Anchor
ascii:
THE FOUR PERSIAN DECREES COMPARED
DECREE:            DATE:       BIBLICAL TEXT:   SCOPE:                RESTORES CITY & STATE?
1. Cyrus           538/537 BC  Ezra 1:1-4       Temple only           NO (Temple only)
2. Darius I        520 BC      Ezra 6:1-12      Reaffirms Temple      NO (Temple only)
3. Artaxerxes I    457 BC      Ezra 7:11-26     Civil law & judges    YES (Restores & Builds)
4. Artaxerxes I    444 BC      Nehemiah 2:1-8   Wall repair permit    NO (Executive permit)

heading: The 69 Weeks to Messiah: The Anointing in A.D. 27
ascii:
THE 69 WEEKS TO MESSIAH THE PRINCE (457 B.C. TO A.D. 27)
457 B.C. ------[ 49 YEARS (7 WEEKS) ]------> 408 B.C. ------[ 434 YEARS (62 WEEKS) ]------> A.D. 27
Decree of Artaxerxes I                      Jerusalem Rebuilt             Baptism of Jesus
Ezra 7:11-26                                Troublous times               "The time is fulfilled" (Mark 1:15)

heading: The Midst of the Week: The Cross in A.D. 31 and Sacrifices Ceasing
ascii:
THE 70TH WEEK OF DANIEL (A.D. 27 TO A.D. 34)
A.D. 27 -----------[ 3.5 YEARS ]-----------> A.D. 31 -----------[ 3.5 YEARS ]-----------> A.D. 34
Baptism of Jesus                           The Cross (Passover)                      Stoning of Stephen
"Time is fulfilled"                        "Messiah cut off"                         Gospel to Gentiles
Ministry to Israel                         Veil rent; sacrifices cease               70 Weeks expire
